name: noise-grain
title: NoiseGrain
description: A film-grain overlay that gives flat surfaces texture, optionally shimmering.

accessibility: The effect layer is aria-hidden and ignores pointer events; only children are exposed.
Keep `opacity` low and re-check text contrast with the grain on.
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it on demand.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) freezes the grain.
